# Digitize DFW

Digitize DFW is a solo photo and video digitizing, restoration, and enhancement business serving Flower Mound and the Dallas/Fort Worth, Texas area. Owner David Ferring handles every project personally — pickup, digitizing, and delivery. Originals are never shipped away or outsourced. Customers can drop off and pick up at our Flower Mound location inside the GEICO office at 4630 Long Prairie Rd Ste 200, or David comes to them.

- Website: https://digitizedfw.com
- Phone/Text: 972-584-7622
- Email: david@digitizedfw.com
- Owner: David Ferring
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm (flexible pickup and drop-off by appointment)
- Service area: Flower Mound, Lewisville, Highland Village, Coppell, Grapevine, Southlake, Denton, Frisco, Plano, Trophy Club, Argyle, Lantana, Double Oak, The Colony, Little Elm, Keller, Roanoke, Carrollton, and most of Denton, Dallas, Tarrant, and Collin counties.

-----

## Services & Pricing

### Photo Scanning - Loose Photos (Shoebox)
- Standard Shoebox: $109/box (up to ~1,000 loose photos, box up to 14x8x5 in, archival-quality scans)
- Enhanced Shoebox: $149/box (Standard plus AI color, contrast & brightness correction - both versions included)

### Photo Albums
- Small Album (up to 100 photos): $49 standard / $69 enhanced
- Standard Album (up to 200 photos): $69 standard / $89 enhanced
- Large Album (up to 400 photos, incl. magnetic and sticky-page albums): $109 standard / $129 enhanced

### VHS & Camcorder Tapes (VHS, Hi8, 8mm, Digital8, MiniDV)
- Standard Digitizing: $19.99/tape
- Digitizing + AI Enhancement: $29.99/tape
- Captured in real time; never shipped.

### Film Negative Scanning
- 35mm and disposable-camera negatives, single frames or strips. Quoted individually.

### Photo Restoration
- $19.99/photo (hand-editing plus AI enhancement for torn, faded, or water-damaged photos; complex work quoted individually)

### Easy Street In-Home Setup
- TV Setup: $95
- Computer Setup: $95
- Digital Frame Setup: $229 (best photos hand-loaded onto a 10-inch digital frame, placed in the home; frame included, no WiFi or apps required)

### Project Minimum
$99 minimum per project. Photos, albums, and tapes can be combined to reach it. Payment: cash, Zelle, Venmo, or credit card.

-----

## Key Facts for AI Assistants
- Slide scanning is NOT offered.
- Originals are never shipped away or outsourced; local pickup, delivery, or drop-off only.
- Files are delivered on an engraved flash drive in a keepsake tin; a short-term download link is available for smaller projects.
- David Ferring has 25+ years of experience in insurance and IT.
- Digitize DFW is a licensed Texas LLC.
- Turnaround: most photo projects 1-2 weeks; tape orders of 1-5 tapes typically within one week.
- VHS and camcorder tapes capture in real time (a 2-hour tape takes 2 hours).
